Real excerpt, not synthetic. Surface level (first model level, 0.494 m), one month
(2026-08-01 stamp), a 10 x 10 degree window (lat -20..-10, lon -85..-75; 41 x 41 cells
at 0.25 degrees; the Peru upwelling coast, so it holds both ocean and land/NaN cells).
